topic: Yuta's cold act toward Yuji was a favour to Gojo
title: Yuta Okkotsu Faked The Whole Yuji Showdown For Gojo
description: When Yuta returned to Jujutsu High, he looked like a threat to Yuji. The wiki says it was an act, and Gojo asked him to play it.
comment: Is Yuta's loyalty to Gojo a strength or a blind spot?

lines.text: Yuta Okkotsu lied to Yuji's face, and Gojo asked him to.
